mentions.name: LocoMo
mentions.description: A cozy world builder indie game built in Godot, drawing gameplay inspiration from Sim City, Rollercoaster Tycoon, and The Sims, with an aesthetic influenced by Stardew Valley and Animal Crossing. The game relies heavily on GPU processing of entities under the hood, taking advantage of tighter CPU/GPU integration and shared memory.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It’s cozy world builder, drawing inspiration for Sim City, Rollercoaster Tycoon, The Sims, with an aesthetic influence of Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, and the like.

This was very much a passion project and an idea I’ve wanted to see alive for decades, and also let me explore some tech I wanted to get deeper on. I’m bullish on the the tighter integration of CPUs, GPU style cores, and shared memory. Our game, LocoMo, relies heavily of GPU processing of entities under the hood.
